fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-07-13, the sister of the complainant, Sanjay Raj, aged 25, left for a temple visit and did not return; the last known location was near Amudham Park Railway Station Road in Thoothukudi. The time of the incident was given as 23:15 on 2026-07-11. The complaint was lodged by Ramya Bai (9000000232), a family member of Sanjay Raj, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000083. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. A witness, Ramesh Pandian, reachable on 9000000469, was mentioned in the complaint.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Last known location noted near a public transport point.
